description: Minimal capability for host-owned analysis windows. These windows render declarative plugin reports or built-in analysis snapshots through trusted app components and hold NO plugin code, so they need window geometry and the event bridge only. They deliberately receive no filesystem, dialog, clipboard, or command-routing permission; copy and interactive analysis actions travel back to the main document over the snapshot/event bridge. Plugin code still executes in a CSP-restricted worker with no IPC.
